_comment: Source of truth for the pom.xml licence gate. Owned by the licence-review owner; Claude must not edit this file. Categories mirror 'eGovernment Foundation - DIGIT 3.0 Licences Review v.1'. Licence ids are SPDX ids where one exists, otherwise the readable keys produced by NAME_PATTERNS in check-pom-licenses.py.
source: eGovernment Foundation - DIGIT 3.0 Licences Review v.1

A.description: Category A: can be included in an Apache 2.0 work

A_CONFIRM.description: Category A, but the review asks for the actual licence text to be confirmed

PENDING.description: Not yet confirmed in the review

B.description: Category B: unmodified binaries only, source must be made available

X.description: Category X: cannot be included in an Apache 2.0 work

notes.jQuery: Confirm the included material is under the MIT text.
notes.Modified-BSD: Confirm the supplied licence text matches BSD 3-Clause.
notes.BSD: Generic 'BSD' name: confirm whether the text is BSD 2-Clause or BSD 3-Clause.
notes.Go: Confirm the applicable terms are BSD 3-Clause (e.g. re2j).
notes.Public-Domain: Confirm the public-domain dedication covers the included copy (e.g. AOP Alliance).
notes.W3C: The review has not confirmed which W3C licence applies (e.g. material in Jersey).
notes.JSON: 'Good, not Evil' use restriction. The review recommends replacing org.json:json:20160810 (via org.everit.json.schema 1.5.1).
